inspection.scope: SectionVIII full indexed potential, adjoining triplet/count statements, and comparison with SectionIII re-read; source notation conflicts resolved explicitly by the displayed invariant.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.
One complex colour-octet SU(2) doublet (8,2)_(1/2) added to the minimal SM. Neutral complex component is decomposed into real and imaginary parts, not independent additional multiplets.

Optional unification completion adds three real colour-singlet weak triplets of zero hypercharge. Source Section VIII calls the octet (8,1)_(1/2), conflicting with the main defined (8,2); conclusion also prints (1,2)_0 for the triplets. Preserve apparent source typographical conflicts instead of silently certifying them.

claims.locator: P09 SectionVIII Eq42 PDF/printedp7, paragraph immediately following; SectionIII scalar definition Eqs5-6
claims.fact: Eq42 contains(S_A^dagger sigma^a S_A)T_j^a and(H^dagger sigma^a H)T_j^a,epsilon_abc T_i^a T_j^b T_k^c; a is weak-adjoint index and j=1..3 labels triplets. Source explicitly says SU2 indices on H and S are suppressed. Thus S is the original weak DOUBLEt, and T consists of THREE real weak TRIPLET copies, colour-singletY0. The SectionVIII(8,1) label and conclusion(1,2) label conflict with these explicit tensors, not with each other as viable alternatives: Pauli-matrix bilinears and epsilon_abc fix the displayed construction. Preserve these source misprints in evidence instead of treating a bare dimension as authoritative or pretending they never occurred.

source_notation_conflict_retained: SectionVIII prose prints(8,1)1/2, but Eq42 explicitly uses weak Pauli matrices onS.
Conclusion prints real(1,2)0, but SectionVIII explicitly real(1,3)0 and indexedadjointT^a.
limitations: This is an indexed-Lagrangian-based editorial correction of source misprints, explicitly disclosed for curator review; it is not a literal agreement of all source prose labels.

description_regime.description: GSM EFT with original octet weak doublet and three real weak triplets, not a separately reconstructed SU5 completion.
